title: Sage
subtitle: Your GM, reading the numbers so you don't have to.

strip.allClear: All clear — nothing needs you right now.
strip.pulseToday: Today so far: {revenue} collected across {orders} closed checks (avg check {avgTicket}).

honesty.notEnoughDataDetail: I don't have figures and a date range I can show for this revenue advice.

briefing.learning: I'm still learning your numbers. After a few days of sales, recipes and shifts, I'll open each day with the read and one move worth making.

read.withPace: {weekday}'s pacing ahead — on track for ~{projected}, about {pace} ahead of a typical {weekdayLower}. {orders} orders in, with the check average holding at {avgTicket}.
read.withPaceBehind: {weekday}'s running a little behind — on track for ~{projected}, about {pace} under a typical {weekdayLower}. {orders} orders in, with the check average at {avgTicket}.
read.noPace: {revenue} in sales so far today, across {orders} orders with a {avgTicket} average check.

health.both: In the kitchen, food cost's at {food} and labor at {labor}.

play.reprice_up: {item} is selling well but underpriced — moving it from {current} to {suggested} could add about {impact} over the next 30 days (estimate).
play.promote: {item} is a quiet winner — strong margin, but under-ordered. Featuring it could add about {impact} over the next 30 days (estimate).
play.ctaAria: Open the Menu tab to act on {item}

win.revenue_up_wow: One bright spot — revenue's up {pct} from last week. Keep it going.

marketing.one: You recorded 1 marketing post in the last {days} days.
marketing.other: You recorded {count} marketing posts in the last {days} days.

outOfStock.one: Inventory for {names} is at zero. Review its usage and restock.
outOfStock.other: {count} inventory items are at zero: {names}. Review their usage and restock.

cards.lowStock: Running low on {count} items: {names}. Reorder before you run dry.

staleBills.one: 1 bill open longer than {duration} — check if a guest slipped out.
staleBills.other: {count} bills open longer than {duration} — check if guests slipped out.

cards.staleBillsOldest: {count} bills still open — the oldest is {duration}. Check if guests slipped out.

aiPending.one: 1 guest chat is waiting on your team to follow up.
aiPending.other: {count} guest chats are waiting on your team to follow up.

foodCostHigh.one: 1 dish is running over 40% food cost: {names}. Worth a look at pricing.
foodCostHigh.other: {count} dishes are running over 40% food cost: {names}. Worth a look at pricing.

cards.wasteHigh: You binned about {amount} of {ingredient} recently — tighten the order or the prep.
cards.laborHigh: Labor's at {pct}% of sales (about {amount}). Worth a glance before payroll.

marketingPosts.one: 1 marketing post was recorded in the last {days} days. Review it in the Library.
marketingPosts.other: {count} marketing posts were recorded in the last {days} days. Review them in the Library.

marketingPostsWithChannel.one: 1 marketing post was recorded in the last {days} days ({channels}). Open the Library to reuse it.
marketingPostsWithChannel.other: {count} marketing posts were recorded in the last {days} days ({channels}). Open the Library to reuse them.

oversold.one: Inventory for {names} is oversold. Count and correct stock before the next service.
oversold.other: {count} inventory items are oversold: {names}. Count and correct stock before the next service.

cards.outOfStockMixed: {count} inventory items need attention — oversold ({oversoldCount}): {oversoldNames}; at zero ({zeroCount}): {zeroNames}. Count and correct stock before the next service.
